description.text: Chinese Language Program (Regular) 6 levels (Elementary A, Elementary B, Intermediate A, Intermediate B, Advanced A, and Advanced B) This program offers systematic and progressive Chinese classes which is available to Chinese learners at different levels. The program is for those who wish to enhance their Chinese progressively to a relatively high level with solid foundation. Elementary A: For beginners who has limited knowledge about Pinyin and Chinese; Elementary B: For those with basic Chinese and are able to express themselves in simple Chinese. Intermediate A: For those with basic language skills and are able to have simple conversations on general topics in Chinese Intermediate B: For those who are able to have discussions on general topics in Chinese. Advanced A: For those who understand Chinese news, and are able to fully express themselves in standard Chinese Advanced B: For those who understand Chinese news and contemporary literatures, and are able to fully express themselves in sophisticated Chinese. Study Duration Duration of the program is from one semester to six semesters. Class ScheduleMonday- Friday, 20 classes each week (40mins per class). Certificate Student who passes all exams will get a certificate of completion. Main Courses Intensive Chinese Reading, Oral Chinese, Chinese Listening, Chinese News Reading, Chinese Audio and Video Comprehensive Course, Daily Topics etc. Selective Courses: Chinese Calligraphy, Tai-Chi, Paper Cutting, Chinese Tea Ceremony, Cantonese. Extra-curriculum Activities Community Survey, Talent Competition, Chinese Corner, Sports

duration.text: The Chinese Language Programs at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1222 USD/per semester ￥ 8800 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1) HITSZ International Student Application Form 2) A copy of passport (the original passport will be checked during registration) 3) One passport-size photo (35mm*50mm)
